jp-twentyfifth-mirait-shinkiba-access.summary: MIRAIT Mobile East gives its Tokyo office as floor 7 of MIRAIT ONE Shinkiba Building, 2-15-20 Shinkiba, and embeds a map of that address. This is the host-property address bridge; the data-center identity comes from MIRAIT ONE’s separate container-facility reports.
jp-twentyfifth-mirait-shinkiba-access.title: Building occupant publishes the exact Shinkiba host address and selected map

status_observation_review.basis: The dated corporate article uses present-tense real-equipment verification and identifies the installed container and named property. Completed means container physical installation; commercial operation is not selected.

jp-twentyfifth-mirait-shinkiba-current-t.summary: MIRAIT ONE describes a 20-foot liquid-cooled container installed on its Shinkiba building property and says real-equipment GPU verification is currently underway. The installation supports the MM Advanced Innovation Lab. Its Delta GoCool-80 liquid-to-air cooling avoids an external primary-water system; the article discusses an envisaged maximum 96 kW cooling capability, not measured IT load. This is an installed demonstration and testing facility, with no commercial service opening established. October 13 is the corporate article publication date, not the installation or filming day.
jp-twentyfifth-mirait-shinkiba-current-t.title: MIRAIT ONE describes its installed Shinkiba liquid-cooled container and current equipment verification

jp-twentyfifth-mirait-shinkiba-host-addr.summary: MIRAIT ONE identifies its Shinkiba Building at 2-15-20 Shinkiba, Koto-ku, Tokyo through the address of its group company on floor 7. The container reports independently name this host building. The office floor is not the container location and the wider building is not described as a dedicated data center.
jp-twentyfifth-mirait-shinkiba-host-addr.title: MIRAIT ONE group directory identifies the Shinkiba building address

jp-twentyfifth-mirait-shinkiba-host-map.summary: The building occupant’s embedded map resolves the named MIRAIT Shinkiba Building at 2-15-20 Shinkiba. The selected property point labels the container’s host premises, not the container position, its footprint or the entire building as a data center.
jp-twentyfifth-mirait-shinkiba-host-map.title: Google Maps selected MIRAIT Shinkiba building address

jp-twentyfifth-mirait-shinkiba-installat.summary: The July 3 notice identifies the first commercial-model 20-foot container as already installed at MIRAIT ONE Shinkiba Building for GPU-server verification. At that time, use as a demonstration facility with high-performance GPUs and IOWN was targeted for September 2026 or later. This target is not proof of service launch. The notice separately dates the joint MIRAIT ONE/MORGENROT laboratory opening to March 18, 2025.
jp-twentyfifth-mirait-shinkiba-installat.title: MIRAIT ONE announces installation at its Shinkiba building

jp-twentyfifth-mirait-shinkiba-lab-histo.summary: The March 2025 announcement names the MM Advanced Innovation Lab within MIRAIT ONE facilities in Shinkiba and planned its opening for March 18. Its work covers cooling, container design and construction methods, AI-development environments and IOWN connections. The later July 2026 notice confirms the historical lab opening. This lab date is distinct from installation of the newer liquid-cooled container.
jp-twentyfifth-mirait-shinkiba-lab-histo.title: MIRAIT ONE and MORGENROT establish the Shinkiba container-data-center research lab

jp-twentyfifth-mirait-shinkiba-site-repo.summary: The July 23 site report describes a verification container with one NVIDIA B200-equipped 4U server, UPS, hot-aisle containment, a liquid-to-air unit and three running in-row air conditioners. It reports an 80 kW CDU rating and three 30 kW air-conditioning units; these are separate cooling specifications, not additive IT power. The visit and equipment-observation day are unspecified. A September-or-later end-user demonstration start remained a target in this report.
jp-twentyfifth-mirait-shinkiba-site-repo.title: Cloud Watch reports the Shinkiba verification container and installed equipment

jp-twentyfifth-mirait-shinkiba-video-dat.summary: The company announced its container-data-center video on September 14 and explicitly gives September 11 as the video publication day. Its October article discusses this video. Neither announcement supplies the filming date, an exact installation day or a commercial opening date.
jp-twentyfifth-mirait-shinkiba-video-dat.title: MIRAIT ONE records September 11 publication of the container-facility video

update.withdrawal_note: Small experimental installations used only to demonstrate or test equipment are outside the Atlas scope. Shinkiba is removed for scope, not because its installed status is disputed; no closure, cancellation or physical status change is inferred.
